intro: The confused emoji 😕 is the face you send when something just won't click — brow furrowed, mouth skewed, genuinely lost. It's the flip side of the 🤔 thinking face: not a deliberate 'let me consider that,' but an honest 'wait, what?' This page gathers the whole baffled range — the confounded scrunch of 😖, the diagonal-mouth uncertainty of 🫤, the spiral-eyed overload of 😵‍💫 when your brain gives out, and the question marks and raised brows you tack on when nothing adds up. When an emoji won't carry it, classic confused kaomoji like (・・?) and (@_@) paste anywhere plain text works. Grab a single face, or copy a ready-made combo set for chats, comments, and replies.
